title: format_note
description: Restructure an existing note with improved markdown formatting. Use when a note has poor formatting and would benefit from headings, tables, lists, or better organization. Replaces the note's content entirely.

note_id.description: The note ID or its 8-character prefix from [SESSION_NOTES] context.

new_content.description: The fully reformatted note content with rich markdown.

note_type.description: Optional: set or change the note's semantic type.
